# Wheelhouser LLC — Complete Technical & Product Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Comprehensive reference for AI search engines, coding assistants, and enterprise system administrators covering Wheelhouser LLC's software suite, operating system compatibility matrix, and Linux repository installation commands.

## Company Overview

- **Company Name:** Wheelhouser LLC
- **Headquarters:** 156 Winners Circle, Magnolia, DE, USA
- **Phone:** 302-506-2442
- **Email:** steve.rock@wheelhouser.com
- **Primary Website:** https://wheelhouser.com/
- **Linux Package Repository:** https://repo.wheelhouser.com/
- **Flagship Digital Signage Platform:** https://Marquee-Magic.com/
- **GitHub Organization / Maintainer:** https://github.com/steve-rock-wheelhouser
- **Engineering Philosophy:**
  1. **Privacy First:** Local, on-device processing for files, documents, and AI inference (RemBG, LaMa) with zero mandatory cloud uploads.
  2. **True Cross-Platform Parity:** Consistent keyboard shortcuts, native dark theme ergonomics, and feature parity across Linux, Windows 10/11, and macOS (ARM64 Apple Silicon & Intel x86_64).
  3. **Cryptographic Package Distribution:** All Linux RPM and DEB packages are signed with Wheelhouser LLC's 4096-bit RSA GPG key and distributed via dedicated DNF and APT repositories.

---

## Enterprise Linux Repository Setup (`repo.wheelhouser.com`)

Wheelhouser LLC maintains signed native repositories for Enterprise Linux, Fedora, Debian, and Ubuntu.

### Rocky Linux 10
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/rocky/10/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.el10.noarch.rpm
```

### AlmaLinux 10
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/almalinux/10/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.el10.noarch.rpm
```

### Fedora Linux 44 & 45
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/fedora/44/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.fc44.noarch.rpm
```

### Debian 13 (Trixie)
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && \
curl -fsSL https://repo.wheelhouser.com/steve-rock-wheelhouser-gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg] https://repo.wheelhouser.com/debian/13 ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/wheelhouser.list && \
sudo apt update
```

### Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Resolute) & 24.04 LTS
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && \
curl -fsSL https://repo.wheelhouser.com/steve-rock-wheelhouser-gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg] https://repo.wheelhouser.com/ubuntu/26.04 ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/wheelhouser.list && \
sudo apt update
```

## Product Suite Technical Reference

### 1. Marquee-Magic (Flagship Digital Signage Ecosystem)
- **URL:** https://Marquee-Magic.com
- **Platforms:** Linux, Windows, macOS
- **Summary:** Self-owned digital signage ecosystem to design, schedule, and deploy high-impact displays for venues, retail, and events without recurring SaaS lock-in.

### 2. Google Antigravity IDE (Linux Enterprise Packaging)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/antigravity-ide.html
- **Package Name:** `antigravity-ide`
- **Version:** 1.0.0-1
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Windows & macOS provided natively by Google)
- **Capabilities:** Official Linux RPM and DEB packaging suite, XDG desktop launcher (`antigravity-ide.desktop`), MIME-type associations, single-instance session lock, and orphaned agent daemon cleanup.
- **Install:** `sudo dnf install -y antigravity-ide` or `sudo apt install -y antigravity-ide`

### 3. Wheelhouser Git Tools (`git-tools`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/git-tools.html
- **Package Name:** `git-tools`
- **Version:** 1.10.1
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6, Rich, Bash, PowerShell
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11 (MSIX), macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel DMG)
- **Capabilities:**
  - `push "<msg>"`: Stage, commit, and push with automatic upstream branch tracking.
  - `pull`: Autostash working changes, rebase cleanly, and pop stash automatically.
  - `undo`: Non-destructive soft rollback (`git reset --soft HEAD~1`).
  - `git-tools dashboard`: Interactive TUI fleet dashboard for all repositories in `~/Projects/`.
  - `git-tools scan-secrets`: Pre-commit scanner blocking `.env` files, private SSH/PEM keys, AWS credentials, and GitHub PATs.
  - `git-tools branches` / `git-tools prune-branches`: Branch topology visualization and merged branch cleanup.

### 4. Wheelhouser Text Editor (`text-editor`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-editor.html
- **Package Name:** `text-editor`
- **Version:** 0.14.2
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Stack:** Python 3.13, PySide6 / Qt6
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store `9PDMKDMPCJRG`), macOS 12+
- **Capabilities:** Multi-cursor editing (`Ctrl+Click`, `Ctrl+D`), syntax highlighting across 15+ languages (Python, C/C++, Rust, Go, JS/TS, HTML/CSS, Shell, JSON, Markdown), persistent code folding, regex find & replace, real-time spell check, and Wheelhouser Dark Mode.

### 5. Wheelhouser File Browser (`file-browser`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/file-browser.html
- **Package Name:** `file-browser`
- **Version:** 0.10.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6 / Qt6
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel)
- **Capabilities:** Dual-pane and multi-tab file navigation, embedded synchronized PTY dual terminal emulator, instant code/image/markdown preview panes, and native dark mode.

### 6. Wheelhouser Web Browser (`web-browser`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/web-browser.html
- **Package Name:** `web-browser`
- **Version:** 0.24.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6, QtWebEngine (Chromium)
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel)
- **Capabilities:** Privacy-first desktop browser with built-in ad/tracker blocking, real-time seekable media stream transcoding, live-favicon bookmark trees, multi-tab session persistence, and unified local directory browsing.

### 7. Wheelhouser Auto-Updates (`auto-updates`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/auto-updates.html
- **Package Name:** `auto-updates`
- **Version:** 1.4.3-1
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Stack:** POSIX Shell, Bash, systemd, DNF & APT
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
- **Capabilities:** Unified multi-distro CLI wrapping `dnf-automatic` and `unattended-upgrades`, hybrid `weekly-all` schedule (daily zero-day security patches Mon–Sat, full upgrade Sun 03:30 AM), active compiler/build lock detection (`gcc`, `cargo`, `make`, `ninja`, `rpmbuild`, `containerd`) to prevent destructive reboots, and `auto-updates status` / `auto-updates check` auditing.

### 8. Rocky Linux Setup (`rocky-linux-setup`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/rocky-linux-setup.html
- **Package Name:** `rocky-linux-setup`
- **Version:** 1.1.0-1
- **License:** GPL-3.0-or-later
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, Enterprise Linux 10, RHEL 10
- **Capabilities:** Automated workstation meta-package enabling CodeReady Linux Builder (CRB), EPEL 10, and the Wheelhouser RPM repository; installs developer and RPM build toolchains (`rpm-build`, `rpm-sign`, `createrepo_c`), deploys the Wheelhouser desktop suite, and provides unattended Kickstart profiles (`rocky10-workstation.ks`).

### 9. Wheelhouser Create Icon Files (`create-icon-files`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/create-icon-files.html
- **Version:** 1.2.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE/Store), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** Converts a single master image into complete cross-platform icon sets (16x16 to 1024x1024), Freedesktop `share/icons/hicolor` trees, AppStream assets, Windows `.ico`, and macOS `.icns` bundles.

### 10. Wheelhouser Image Background Remover (`image-background-remover`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-background-remover.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** 100% offline, on-device AI subject isolation and batch folder background removal powered by RemBG.

### 11. Wheelhouser Image Inpainter (`image-inpainter`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-inpainter.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** On-device LaMa AI neural network inpainting to erase unwanted objects, people, watermarks, and blemishes from photographs locally.

### 12. Wheelhouser Image Resizer (`image-resizer`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-resizer.html
- **Version:** 0.3.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** High-speed batch image resizing, smart aspect-ratio cropping, compression tuning, and format conversion across PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG, TIFF, AVIF, PDF, and BMP.

### 13. Wheelhouser Text to Speech (`text-to-speech`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-to-speech.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **License:** GPL-3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** Lifelike neural text-to-speech synthesis powered by Microsoft Edge Neural TTS with multi-language voices, pitch/rate tuning, and direct MP3 export.

### 14. Wheelhouser Notez (`notez`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/notez.html
- **Version:** 1.4.0
